Teacher Eyes Only

Solutions for Level I: Verification.

Objective

This level is for verification and reflection. Students do not write new code.

They must play the game to completion (collect the 4 key items, open the airlock, defeat the boss, and escape).

Key Items & Locations

  • 🔑 Command Keycard: Hidden in Command Centre (Interact with panel).
  • 🔋 Control Cell: In Research Lab.
  • 🔧 Crowbar: In Main Corridor or Maintenance (used to open Supply Closet).
  • 🔦 Flashlight: In Maintenance (Needed for dark rooms).
  • 💾 Data Chip: In Research Lab (Allows non-violent boss win).

The Boss Fight

Option A: Combat

Attack the Security Chief. He has 55 HP and 3 Armour. Need a good weapon (Plasma Cutter in Armoury) and Med Patches.

Option B: Tech Solution (Non-Violent)

If they found the Data Chip, they can choose "Use Item" -> "Data Chip" in combat to disable him instantly.

Verification Checklist

  • ✅ Player has name and class descriptive text.
  • ✅ Inventory limits (10 items) work.
  • ✅ Items can be used (healing/buffs).
  • ✅ NPCs respond to dialogue choice.
  • ✅ Combat loop works (Attack/Damage).
  • ✅ Save/Load restores exactly the same state.
